description: One published map as Markdown: description and sources, the timeline of keyframes (date and caption), layers, events, and the iframe code to embed the interactive map. Pass its URL, or the handle and slug.

slug.description: The last part of the map's URL, e.g. the-ottoman-empire-12991923

username.description: The map owner's handle, e.g. chrisjager (with slug, instead of url)

name: get_public_map
title: Get a published map
